title: Armor: Chest
description: Replicate the chest armor piece from Blender-Procedural-Human in Ixdar DSL. Source: procedural_human/geo_node_groups/armor/chest.py (~21k lines). Most complex piece. Key techniques: bi_rail_loft, pipes, rivet, gem_in_holder, gold_on_band, gold_decorations, bezier segments, mesh-to-curve, extrude-mesh, separate-geometry. May need new utility DSL patterns for gem_in_holder and gold_on_band.
definition-of-done: 1. chest.dsl compiles without errors. 2. Mesh comparison gate passes. 3. Visual comparison shows recognizable silhouette match.
testing-plan: 1. Export Blender reference OBJ. 2. Run validate-dsl to export generated OBJ. 3. Run mesh_distance() comparison. 4. Visual inspection.
